_readme: Site news feed. Edit this file, run scripts/make-updates.py, commit. The script regenerates the homepage 'What's new' grid between its UPDATES markers. First entry = lead story (large tile). 'status' is one of: live, update, dev, research, resources.

updates.title: ASCENT — climb Everest in your browser
updates.desc: Walk the real mountain: Esri imagery over a live elevation model, the South Col route, oxygen, weather and crevasses. Pick a camp and go.

updates.title: The Mars Flight Simulator is live
updates.desc: Real Martian terrain, CTX imagery streaming beneath you. Launch from anywhere on the planet.

updates.title: Mt. Etna Volcano Explorer
updates.desc: Geological overlays, regional faults and the subsurface cross-section are now live.

updates.title: Planet Explorer
updates.desc: Navigate all ten worlds in interactive 3D.

updates.title: myGeoID prototype
updates.desc: Personalised dashboards, saved locations and custom alert profiles.

updates.title: Research Hub, inside GeoHUB
updates.desc: Projects on disk, ingest, analysis and figures — in the same window as the globe.
